## Purpose and scope

Related Issue(s), base SHA/tree, changed responsibilities and explicit non-goals:

## Evidence

- [ ] Read AGENTS.md and the Issue's prerequisites.
- [ ] Report exact commands, environment and actual pass/fail/skip/xfail results.
- [ ] Include RED/GREEN evidence for a bug fix, or characterization for refactoring.
- [ ] Verify a clean wheel outside the source checkout when executable code changes.
- [ ] Document API/schema/cache migration or explain why none applies.
- [ ] Keep observed speech, normalized text and score semantics distinct.
- [ ] No private audio, credentials, unapproved data or unreviewed weights in git.

For research/training: preregistration, split/model/runtime hashes, all trials,
weight-update/checkpoint/reload evidence when training, paired evaluation and failures:

## Completion boundary

Engineering-complete / experiment-complete / partial / blocked:
Separate promotion decision, limitations and rollback:
Do not close an epic or a weight-training Issue with documentation alone.
